blocks.text: Pakistan ke paas kai raw materials (kaccha maal) hain jo is ki chemical industries ke liye ahem hain. Kisi industry ka feedstock (woh kaccha maal jis se cheez banti hai) tay karta hai ke industry kahan lagegi aur maali taur par kamyab (economically viable) hogi ya nahi.

Hawa fertilizers ke liye nitrogen aur steel banane ke liye oxygen deti hai. Paani solvent (ghoolne wala maaya), thanda karne wali cheez (cooling agent) aur hydrogen hasil karne ke zariye ke taur par use hota hai. Fossil fuels, jaise koyla (coal), tel (oil) aur qudrati gas (natural gas), woh hydrocarbons dete hain jin se 90% organic chemicals bante hain.
Pakistan ki zameen ki banawat (geological profile) khaas hai, jo kai chemical sub-sectors ko sahara deti hai, maslan:

items: Natural Gas (qudrati gas): Yeh methane (CH₄) ka bara zariya hai, jis se fertilizers (urea) aur petrochemicals bante hain. Yeh fuel bhi hai aur hydrogen ka zariya bhi.

Rock Salt (sendha namak, Khewra Mines): Khewra ki kaanein duniya ke sab se bare namak ke zakheeron mein se hain. Yeh sodium chloride (NaCl) ka zariya hai, jo soda ash (Na₂CO₃), caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine banane ka kaccha maal hai.
Limestone (choona pathar): Salt Range aur Sindh mein bohat milta hai. Yeh cement industry ke liye calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) ka zariya hai.
Gypsum: Cement industry aur plaster banane mein use hota hai. Yeh calcium aur sulphur ka zariya bhi hai aur mitti ko behtar banane (soil conditioner) mein bhi istemal hota hai.
Chromite: Muslim Bagh mein milta hai; stainless steel aur pigments (rang) banane mein use hota hai.
Crude Oil (kaccha tel): Isay saaf (refine) kar ke tarah tarah ke fuels aur petrochemicals banaye jaate hain.
Sulphur: Is se sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) banta hai, jo industry ka aik bohat ahem chemical hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did You Know?)
blocks.text: Pakistan ke paas bohat qudrati gas hai, jo urea (NH₂CONH₂) banane ka asal kaccha maal hai. Kaccha maal mulk mein hi milne se paidawar ka kharcha kam aata hai, aur khaad kisanon ke liye sasti ho jaati hai.

blocks.prompt: Khewra ka kaun sa kaccha maal soda ash aur caustic soda banane mein use hota hai?

items: Hawa (N₂, O₂), paani aur fossil fuels (90% organic chemicals) bunyadi kaccha maal hain.
Pakistan: natural gas, Khewra ka rock salt, limestone, gypsum, Muslim Bagh ka chromite, crude oil, sulphur.
Maqami gas se urea sasti banti hai.
